summary: Iter 53 — Owner Security PIN + SMS packs (Razorpay LIVE — order-create only) + Branch-switch OTP/PIN gating. BACKEND 15/15 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter53_pin_sms_branch.py, --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter53_results.xml). Verified: (a) GET /api/settings/security-pin returns {set:true}; PUT without current_pin → 403; PUT with current_pin=new_pin=4321 → 200 (PIN left as 4321). (b) require_owner_pin guard on POST /staff (no header → 403 OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED, X-Owner-Pin=9999 → 403, X-Owner-Pin=4321 → creates staff). Same guard verified on PUT /staff/{id} (403 → 200), POST /staff/{id}/advance (403 without pin, PIN accepted — 400 business error 'No advance limit set' is downstream of the guard, so PIN gate itself is proven), POST /attendance/{id}/waive-fine (403 without pin). Delete verified via fixture teardown. (c) GET /api/sms-packs returns {enabled:true, packs:[pack_199/499/999 with price+points], balance:int}; POST /api/sms-packs/order pack_199 returns order_id starting 'order_', amount=19900, key_id starting 'rzp_live_'; POST /api/sms-packs/verify with fake sig → 400 'signature verification failed' (the pass condition — no LIVE payment attempted). (d) POST /branch-switch/request returns {request_id, owner_email:'ad***@…', email_sent:bool}. GET /branch-switch/pending includes the OTP (6 digits). POST /branch-switch/verify wrong otp → 400 'Incorrect OTP' (attempts++), right otp → {ok:true}, replay same → 400. POST /branch-switch/owner-pin {pin:'4321'} → 200; wrong pin → 403. POST /branch-switch/{id}/deny → 200 and row disappears from pending. FRONTEND (Playwright, 1920×1080, cookie auth): (1) Settings → security-pin-card present, pin-status-badge shows 'PIN active' after API resolves. (2) Settings → sms-packs-card present, sms-balance-chip shows '87 points left', buy-pack_199 button present; clicking opens Razorpay checkout overlay (.razorpay-container detected) — CLOSED IMMEDIATELY via Escape + DOM removal, NO payment initiated. (3) Staff page → click edit-staff-{id} opens StaffFormModal; click save-staff-btn triggers window.prompt('🔒 Owner Security PIN required…'). With PIN=4321 → 'Staff updated' toast (success). With PIN=1111 → toasts: 'OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED' (raw backend detail) followed by 'Incorrect PIN — action blocked'. (4) BranchSwitcher (top header) → after clearing sessionStorage.branch_switch_verified, selecting a different branch opens branch-switch-modal with both tab-owner-pin and tab-otp. Owner-PIN path: enter 4321 in owner-pin-input → owner-pin-submit → modal closes, 'Welcome, owner — branch switched' toast, select value updates, sessionStorage.branch_switch_verified='1'. (5) Dashboard branch-switch-approvals widget: after POST /api/branch-switch/request via fetch(credentials:'include'), the amber card renders with switch-otp-{id} showing the 6-digit code, switch-share-{id} (WhatsApp) and switch-deny-{id} buttons; clicking deny removes the row from the widget. All 4 major features working end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: On wrong PIN, two toasts stack: the raw backend detail 'OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED' (from the first 403) AND then the user-friendly 'Incorrect PIN — action blocked'. The raw code-string toast is UX noise — pinApi should swallow the initial OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED 403 silently (since it always triggers the prompt) and only show the friendly toast on retry failure.

issues: pin-status-badge briefly shows 'Not set' for ~1s while /api/settings/security-pin loads, then flips to 'PIN active'. Consider a neutral 'Checking…' placeholder or hiding the badge until the request resolves to avoid a false 'Not set' flash for owners who DO have a PIN set.

action_items: (LOW UX) In /app/frontend/src/lib/ownerPin.js, swallow the raw 'OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED' toast — that response is expected on the first probe request; only surface the 'Incorrect PIN' toast after the retry actually fails.
(LOW UX) In SecurityPinCard.jsx, avoid the 'Not set' → 'PIN active' flash on load (initial state should be 'Checking…' until the /settings/security-pin promise resolves).
critical_code_review_comments: require_owner_pin (server.py L766-777) is correctly ordered AFTER get_current_user + current_tenant and is a no-op when no PIN is set — good progressive-enhancement design; super_admin is exempted, which is correct for HQ operations.

SMS packs (server.py L4651-4696): sms_pack_verify uses find_one_and_update({status:'created'}) to atomically claim the pending order, preventing replay/re-use — matches the /billing/razorpay/verify pattern. Points come from the server-side pending record, never the client payload. Good.

Branch-switch verify (L842-859) uses hmac.compare_digest for OTP comparison and increments attempts to 5-strike lockout. Expired requests also transition to status='expired' so pending list stays clean. LGTM.
SecurityPinCard.jsx sends {new_pin, current_pin: currentPin || null} — backend ignores null current_pin only when no PIN is set, otherwise 403. Good defence-in-depth.

server.py continues to grow (~6391 lines now, +213 from last iter). Split-out flagged in iter50/51/52 still outstanding — the new branch-switch + sms-packs blocks are natural candidates for extraction into routers/security.py and routers/sms_packs.py.

pinApi (frontend/src/lib/ownerPin.js) uses window.prompt() — acceptable for admin-only screens but not ideal for mobile UX. A shadcn Dialog with number input + remember-in-session toggle would be a future polish.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all 5 in-scope flows (Settings cards, Razorpay overlay open+close, Staff PIN prompt right+wrong, BranchSwitcher gating with PIN, Dashboard approval widget deny). OTP branch-switch UI flow not exercised via Playwright (backend contract for the full request→verify→replay flow is fully covered by 3 pytest cases) — main agent can self-verify OTP UI in 30s if needed.
